overview_description.description: Ferry Health provides AI-powered concierge services that help patients find and schedule healthcare appointments. The company offers hosted web applications and text-based services that guide patients through selecting in-network providers and booking follow-up or specialty care. Ferry Health works with health systems, care coordinators, and health insurers to handle referral follow-up, appointment outreach, and coordination tasks. Its platform engages patients via messaging, presents curated appointment options, and completes bookings based on patient preferences and insurance coverage. The service is used across primary care and numerous specialties to support timely access to scheduled care and reduce administrative workload for care teams.
